function: Cascaded BS-RIS-device channel estimation from received pilots with a DNN (scenario classifier, feature extractors, feature mapper); a second learned part allocates resources by DBRL (pp. 4-5).
system: BS 4x4 UPA (16 antennas), passive reflecting RIS with 8x8 elements and practical phase-dependent amplitude, single-antenna devices, 10 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 7).
method: CDL: supervised CNN (scenario classifier, feature extractors, mapper) trained on local data with gradients aggregated per scenario, LS labels; DBRL: WGAN-GP distributional reinforcement learning (pp. 4-8).
data_channel: Simulated Saleh-Valenzuela BS-RIS and RIS-device channels; 4000 samples per device (3000 training, 1000 test); labels from LS estimates (pp. 3, 5, 7).
test_conditions: Same simulated channels for training and testing (3000 train, 1000 test samples per device); only SNR varied, about 1 to 12 dB (p. 7, Fig. 4).
baselines: CDL versus LS and MMSE only (non-learned); no learned estimator compared; the DBRL allocation is shown without any baseline (p. 7, Fig. 4).
metrics: Channel estimation RMSE versus SNR, scenario classifier accuracy, energy efficiency, QoS satisfaction rate, and system utility versus iterations (pp. 7-9).
q1_support: p. 3: "the Saleh-Valenzuela channel"; a custom simulated channel (setup on p. 7), with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 7: "training dataset and the remaining 1000 are used as the training" [sic]; held-out samples of the same data, only SNR varied (Fig. 4), no unseen scenario, array size, or pilot length.
q3_support: p. 7: "Specifically, under low SNR conditions, traditional LS and"; Fig. 4 compares the CDL only with LS and MMSE (non-learned), with no learned estimator, and the DBRL allocation has no baseline.
q4_support: p. 3: "computational efficiency in RIS-aided network and communication"; qualitative claim only (also p. 6, the gradient penalty "adds computational complexity"), with no FLOPs, parameters, complexity order, or runtime reported.
q5_support: p. 7: "collect 4000 samples, out of which 3000 are used as the"; self-simulated data, with no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 2 on the CDL cascaded channel estimator (pp. 4-5, 7). The WGAN-GP distributional RL resource allocation never defines its state or action space (only bandwidth is described, p. 7), so it is not taken as a physical-layer function; the reviewer may check whether it configures the RIS or beams (area 3). CDL training is distributed with digital gradient aggregation, not over the air. The text calls the test set 'training' (p. 7).
